generationInputs.prompt: A vintage snark poster features an eggplant, a banana, and a green chili with white gloves, all wielding syringes and surrounded by viscous white liquid, embodying a retro, satirical aesthetic. The poster depicts an anthropomorphic eggplant holding a glowing syringe, with its "skin" appearing glossy and dark purple. Beside it, a banana, also anthropomorphized, is shown with a similar glowing syringe, its yellow peel slightly bruised, suggesting a worn look. A vibrant green chili, equipped with pristine white gloves, firmly grips another glowing syringe. Streams of bright, viscous white liquid are splattered around and between the vegetable characters, creating a dynamic and somewhat chaotic scene. The overall style is reminiscent of vintage propaganda or advertising posters, utilizing bold outlines, muted yet distinct colors, and a distressed texture to achieve a snarky, satirical tone.
